title: PR & Communications - Senior Manager
description:
Fieldfisher is a leading international law firm with an ambitious growth agenda and an exceptionally supportive, friendly and dynamic culture.

We are looking for an experienced Senior PR and Communications Manager to join our friendly and fast-paced PR and Communications team, which supports the firm's sectors, practices and corporate communications priorities.

As a senior member of the team, the Senior Manager will act as a trusted communications adviser to partners and business leaders. They will take ownership of a portfolio of priority sectors and practices, developing and delivering integrated communications programmes that support business objectives, strengthen the firm's reputation and raise the profile of its experts.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy and senior stakeholder counsel
- Lead the development and implementation of PR and communications strategies for aligned sectors and practices, ensuring activity supports the firm's business priorities and growth ambitions.
- Act as a trusted adviser to partners, sector and practice leaders and senior business services stakeholders, providing clear and commercially focused communications counsel.
- Translate complex business, legal and market issues into compelling communications opportunities and clear, accessible narratives.

Media relations and profile-raising
- Lead proactive media engagement for aligned sectors and practices, ensuring Fieldfisher's experts have a credible voice on the issues that matter to clients and prospects.
- Build and maintain influential relationships with journalists across legal, national, international and trade media.
- Identify and develop strong stories from client work, market developments, research, business milestones and the expertise of the firm's people.

Content and integrated campaigns
- Develop creative, integrated communications for campaigns and projects in partnership with business development, marketing, digital and international colleagues.
- Oversee and produce high-quality content, including news releases, commentary, op-eds and articles, adapting tone and format for different audiences and channels.

Internal communications and profile-raising
- Develop internal communications for aligned sectors and practices, using the firm's intranet and other channels to showcase achievements, support strategic priorities and improve engagement.
- Contribute to firm-wide internal communications projects where required, working collaboratively with the firm's internal communications specialists.

Team and network leadership
- Collaborate with communications and marketing colleagues across Fieldfisher's international network to support cross-border campaigns and share effective approaches.
- Provide guidance, constructive feedback and informal coaching to colleagues, contributing to the development of capability and consistently high standards across the team.
- Contribute to team planning, prioritisation and the continuous improvement of communications processes, tools and ways of working.

Qualifications and Experience
- At least eight years' relevant PR and communications experience gained in-house, in an agency or through a combination of both.
- Experience within a law firm; relevant experience in another complex, regulated or business-to-business environment will also be considered.
- A strong record of developing and delivering successful communications strategies and integrated content campaigns that support business objectives and produce tangible outcomes.
- Well-established media relations skills, with evidence of building productive relationships with journalists and securing high-quality national, legal, trade or sector coverage.
- Excellent writing, editing and proofreading skills, with the ability to make complex issues clear and compelling and adapt content for different styles, audiences and channels.

What do we offer?
- In the office or WFH?: We think the best balance is more time in the office than at home, so we operate a 60:40 rule.
- Beyond salary: We offer plenty of benefits; private medical insurance, health cash plan, dental insurance, life assurance, critical illness insurance, matched pension contributions up to 7%, holiday trading, plus many more.

Why join Fieldfisher?

At Fieldfisher, we know people do their best work when they feel supported, valued and able to be themselves.

We invest in helping our people build fulfilling careers while maintaining a healthy balance with life outside work. From professional development opportunities and wellbeing initiatives to flexible ways of working, we're committed to creating an environment where people can thrive.

As part of our People First approach, we offer a range of support for colleagues and their families.

Inclusiveness and diversity

At Fieldfisher, led by the social model of disability, we are working towards removing accessibility barriers and maximising disability and neurodiversity inclusion in our recruitment processes.

Should you have any accessibility requirements, please contact a member of Fieldfisher's Recruitment Team, who will work with you to implement suitable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. All conversations are treated in the strictest confidence, and we would appreciate your feedback to help us provide an accessible and enjoyable recruitment process

What to do next:
- Click 'Apply Now', complete an online application and upload a CV. Please note that CVs will not be accepted via email in line with our data privacy policy.
- Successful applications will be invited to a 20-30-minute introductory call with a recruiter.
- Every role recruits differently. But we'll always let you know what to expect from the process, so you get no surprises.
- For hybrid opportunities, you'll be invited to visit our offices for a face-to-face meeting.
- We try to make sure the process takes around 2-3 weeks only, but we can't always promise that. We will work around everyone's availability.

title: Senior Manager - CRM & Relationship Intelligence
description:
We have an exciting opportunity for a Senior Manager - CRM & Relationship Intelligence to join our Marketing team. This opportunity is open to A&O Shearman's London or Belfast office.
Marketing team
Our Marketing team helps the firm win and grow the right clients and work. We drive client development across the firm, deepening priority relationships, increasing share of wallet and converting strategic opportunities into profitable revenue. We equip partners with effective go-to-market strategies, tactics and processes, differentiated insights and disciplined execution. Alongside this, we strengthen the firm's market profile and reputation to support client acquisition, retention, and growth. We work as one integrated global team, aligning central support and expertise with local knowledge and execution to maximize impact across offices, practice groups, sectors and client programs.
The marketing Technology team is responsible for the strategy, implementation, governance, and ongoing management of the firm's marketing, business development, and client relationship technology ecosystem. The team delivers and supports the platforms, data, integrations, and digital capabilities that underpin client development, relationship intelligence, marketing operations, and business growth.
The team manages a broad portfolio of technologies, including CRM and relationship intelligence platforms, marketing automation tools, digital marketing channels, data and analytics solutions, client and public websites, content management systems, social media publishing tools, and related marketing applications. The firm has invested heavily in our technology, data and AI, including the global implementation of Microsoft Dynamics. Working closely with Marketing, Business Development, Technology, Data, AI and Information Security teams, the function drives adoption, data quality, innovation, and operational excellence across the firm's marketing technology landscape.
What you will do
The Senior Manager, CRM & Relationship Intelligence is responsible for maximising the business value of the firm's CRM and relationship intelligence technologies and capabilities. Reporting to the Global Head of Marketing Data, AI and Technology, the role owns the firm's CRM product roadmap, business requirements, adoption and value realisation, ensuring trusted client and relationship data supports stronger relationships, better relationships intelligence and opportunity identification and more coordinated client development.
The role will lead the evolution of CRM from a system of record towards an intelligent client-development capability, using Microsoft Dynamics 365, relationship intelligence, analytics, automation and AI to turn trusted data into timely, actionable insight.
Working across Marketing, Business Development, Technology, Data, Risk and Information Security, the Senior Manager will ensure that CRM processes, data and technology evolve in line with the wider Marketing Data, AI and Technology strategy and provide a strong foundation for AI-enabled experiences across the Microsoft ecosystem.
We are looking for a talented and personable expert with a strong understanding of CRM marketing tooling, data privacy experience, and a proven track record of delivery. Experience of MS Dynamics and the wider MS tech stack is essential.
CRM Strategy & Platform Ownership
Own the delivery and continuous improvement of the firm's CRM and relationship intelligence roadmap, under the strategic direction of the Global Head of Marketing Data, AI and Technology.
- Contribute to the development and execution of the firm's CRM strategy and roadmap.
- Act as the owner for CRM capabilities, integrations, user experience, and day-to-day platform effectiveness.
- Identify opportunities to leverage CRM data, relationship intelligence, AI, automation, and analytics to enhance client engagement, cross-selling, and commercial effectiveness.
- Lead the prioritization and delivery of enhancements, with technology teams, vendors, business stakeholders.

Stakeholder Management
- Translate business requirements into solutions that support business objectives and user needs.
- Facilitate CRM governance forums, gathering stakeholder feedback and prioritizing enhancement requests.
- Build strong relationships with senior business stakeholders, providing regular updates on platform performance, adoption, key initiatives, and delivery progress.
- Escalate risks, dependencies, and strategic considerations to the Global Head of Marketing, Data, AI and Technology.

AI and technology
Support and promote the effective use of AI, automation, and advanced analytics within the CRM and relationship intelligence ecosystem, identifying opportunities to enhance client insights, improve business development effectiveness, automate manual processes, and increase the value derived from firm relationship data.
- Identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and predictive analytics to improve relationship insights, contact management, data quality, pipeline visibility, and cross-selling opportunities.
- Define and track success measures for AI-enabled CRM initiatives, demonstrating improvements in productivity, data quality, user adoption, client insight generation, and business development outcomes.

Data Governance & Quality
- Implement CRM data governance standards and policies in alignment with firm-wide frameworks.
- Lead initiatives to improve CRM data integrity, completeness, consistency, accuracy, and compliance.
- Collaborate with Risk, Compliance, Information Security, and Data Privacy teams to ensure appropriate data handling, access controls, and regulatory compliance.
- Monitor data quality KPIs and metrics, identifying trends, risks, and opportunities for continuous improvement.

Platform Administration & Optimization
- Oversee the day-to-day administration of the CRM platform.
- Monitor platform performance and user experience, identifying opportunities to improve functionality, adoption, reliability, and operational effectiveness.
- Work with Technology teams and vendors to support platform upgrades, testing, integrations, issue resolution.
- Lead the delivery of CRM enhancements and projects, from requirements gathering and business case development through implementation, change management, and user adoption.
- Ensure CRM capabilities and processes remain aligned with business requirements.

Reporting & Analytics
- Develop and maintain CRM dashboards, reports, and insight solutions that provide actionable visibility into client relationships, pipeline activity, marketing effectiveness, and business development performance.
- Provide CRM-derived insights and analysis to support business planning, client development initiatives, and decision-making by marketing and business development leaders.
- Collaborate with stakeholders to identify reporting requirements and translate business needs into scalable reporting and analytics solutions.
- Drive the adoption of reporting and self-service analytics capabilities, enabling data-driven decisions.
- Monitor reporting effectiveness and data quality, recommending enhancements to improve insight generation.

Team leadership and development
- Provide leadership, direction, coaching, and development opportunities to team members, setting high standards for performance, collaboration, client focus, and delivery excellence.
- Work with project manager, project sponsor and core members of the MS Dynamics project team - leading the day-to-day aspects of the project as the firm's product owner.
- Build team capability in CRM, relationship intelligence, data management, reporting, and business partnering.
- Create opportunities for team members to engage with stakeholders, client development activities, progressively building their confidence, commercial awareness, and leadership capabilities.

Adoption & Change Management
- Lead the planning and delivery of CRM adoption initiatives, embed effective ways of working.
- Develop and deliver training, communications, best practice frameworks and user enablement programmes.
- Monitor user adoption, engagement, and satisfaction, identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.
- Partner with champions to drive behavioural change and increase the quality of CRM data and processes.
- Gather user feedback and insights to inform enhancements, training priorities, and future adoption activities.

Vendor Management & Platform Partnerships
Manage key CRM vendor relationships to ensure high-quality service delivery, continuous platform improvement, and alignment with business requirements, while providing recommendations to support technology investment.
- Act as the primary operational relationship manager for CRM, relationship intelligence, and related marketing technology vendors, ensuring services are delivered in line with business requirements and agreed service levels.
- Build effective working relationships with technology partners, acting as a key point of contact for platform enhancements, issue resolution, product updates, and ongoing support.
- Monitor vendor performance and project deliverables, escalating risks and service issues where required.
- Coordinate vendor-led implementations, upgrades, integrations, and enhancement initiatives.
- Support vendor evaluation, procurement, contract renewals, and business case development by providing operational insights, requirements, and performance assessments click apply for full job details

title: Trainee Digital Marketing Manager No experience needed (Ref: 6901)
description:
DIGITAL MARKETING TRAINEESHIP (REMOTE)

Become a Digital Marketing Professional and Build Real-World Experience

Are you interested in digital marketing, online business, and helping organisations grow through effective marketing strategies? Do you want to gain practical experience while developing skills that employers are actively looking for?

We are offering a Digital Marketing Traineeship designed to help aspiring digital marketers develop industry-relevant knowledge through structured learning and practical projects.

What You Will Learn

Throughout the traineeship, you will develop an understanding of:
- Digital Marketing Fundamentals
- Marketing Strategy and Planning
- Search Engine Optimisation (SEO)
- Pay-Per-Click (PPC) Advertising
- Social Media Marketing
- Content Marketing
- Email Marketing
- Google Analytics and Marketing Analytics
- Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO)
- Customer Journey Mapping
- Branding and Positioning
- Market Research and Competitor Analysis
- Artificial Intelligence (AI) for Marketing
- Marketing Automation
- Campaign Planning and Performance Measurement
- Marketing Reporting and Data Analysis

Practical Experience

You will work on realistic marketing projects that may include:
- Developing digital marketing strategies
- SEO audits and optimisation recommendations
- Social media campaign planning
- Content creation and marketing calendars
- Email marketing campaigns
- Marketing analytics and reporting
- Website optimisation projects
- Competitor research
- Brand positioning exercises
- Portfolio projects demonstrating your marketing skills

This practical experience will help you develop a professional portfolio that demonstrates your capabilities to future employers.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for individuals who:
- Have an interest in marketing, business, and technology
- Enjoy analysing data and solving problems
- Have good communication skills
- Are creative and eager to learn
- Can work independently and manage their time effectively
- Have basic computer skills

No previous digital marketing experience is required. Successful applicants will undertake our paid Digital Marketing training programme before progressing into employment. The cost of the training is the responsibility of the learner, and full guidance and support will be provided throughout the programme.

Benefits
- Remote and flexible learning
- Industry-relevant curriculum
- Portfolio development opportunities
- Practical project experience
- Mentoring and personalised feedback
- Career guidance and employability support
- Opportunity to develop skills sought by modern employers

Entry Requirements
- A good level of written English
- Access to a computer and internet connection
- Motivation to learn and develop professionally

Career Opportunities

Upon successful completion, learners may pursue roles such as:
- Digital Marketing Executive
- Digital Marketing Specialist
- SEO Executive
- PPC Executive
- Content Marketing Executive
- Social Media Executive
- Email Marketing Executive
- Marketing Coordinator
- Marketing Analyst
- Growth Marketing Executive
- Performance Marketing Executive
- Digital Marketing Assistant

Apply Today

If you are looking to start a career in Digital Marketing and want to gain practical experience while developing a professional portfolio, we would love to hear from you.

Submit your application today and begin your journey towards a career in one of the world's fastest-growing industries.

We advertise this role across multiple UK locations - you only need to apply once and you'll be considered for all of them.
